arxiv-2406-17864.creator: Yi Zeng, Kevin Klyman, Andy Zhou, Yu Yang, Minzhou Pan, Ruoxi Jia, Dawn Song, Percy Liang, Bo Li
arxiv-2406-17864.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive AI risk taxonomy derived from eight government policies from the European Union, United States, and China and 16 company policies worldwide, making a significant step towards establishing a unified language for generative AI safety evaluation. arxiv-2503-02620.title: FGM Modeling of Thermo-Diffusive Unstable Lean Premixed Hydrogen-Air Flames Journal: Combustion and Flame
arxiv-2503-02620.creator: Stijn N.J. Schepers, Jeroen A. van Oijen
arxiv-2503-02620.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Stijn N.J. Schepers, Jeroen A. van Oijen. Ultra-lean premixed hydrogen combustion is a possible solution to decarbonize industry, while limiting flame temperatures and thus nitrous oxide emissions. These lean hydrogen/air flames experience strong preferential diffusion effects, which result in thermo-diffusive (TD) instabilities. To efficiently and accurately model lean premixed hydrogen flames, it is crucial to incorporate these preferential diffusion effects into flamelet tabulated chemistry frameworks, such as the Flamelet-Generated Manifold (FGM) method.

arxiv-2504-03927.title: Dimensionless learning based on information
arxiv-2504-03927.creator: Yuan Yuan & Adrián Lozano-Durán, ∗ Corresponding author. Email: yuany999@mit.edu
arxiv-2504-03927.description: Abstract Dimensional analysis is one of the most fundamental tools for understanding physical systems. However, the construction of dimensionless variables, as guided by the Buckingham- π \pi theorem, is not uniquely determined. Here, we introduce IT- π \pi , a model-free method that combines dimensionless learning with the principles of information theory.

arxiv-2505-17273.creator: A. Andrade, I. Saviane, L. Monaco, M. Gullieuszik
arxiv-2505-17273.description: Abstract Context. Studying metal-poor galaxies is crucial for the understanding of physical mechanisms that drive the formation and evolution of galaxies, such as internal dynamics, star formation history, and chemical enrichment. Most of the observational works in dwarf galaxies employ integral field spectroscopy to investigate gas physics in the entire body of galaxies.

arxiv-2512-09371.title: Constraining the outer boundary condition for the Babcock-Leighton dynamo models
arxiv-2512-09371.creator: Yukun Luo, Jie Jiang, Binghang Li, Zebin Zhang, Ruihui Wang
arxiv-2512-09371.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yukun Luo, Jie Jiang, Binghang Li, Zebin Zhang, Ruihui Wang. The evolution of the Sun’s large-scale surface magnetic field is well captured by surface flux transport models, which can therefore provide a natural constraint on the outer boundary condition (BC) of Babcock–Leighton (BL) dynamo models. For the first time, we propose a zero radial diffusion BC for BL dynamo models, enabling their surface field evolution to align consistently with surface flux transport simulations.

pmc-12751531.description: BackgroundSmall yellow croaker, Larimichthys polyactis, is a marine fish species of significant commercial importance in China and Korea, yet it suffers from various challenges including genetic degradation and disease problem. pmc-13054200.title: Blue Rubber Bleb Nevus Syndrome: Case-Driven Insights Into a Rare Cause of Refractory Gastrointestinal Bleeding
pmc-13054200.creator: Edwin Ornelas Escobedo, Laura V Cupil Escobedo, Santiago Philibert-Rosas, Ceriolith Tenorio Flores, Ariosto H Hernandez Lara, Luis E Zamora Nava
pmc-13054200.description: Blue rubber bleb nevus syndrome (BRBNS) is a rare vascular disorder causing chronic iron-deficiency anemia from gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding. We described the case of a 17-year-old Latin American patient with refractory anemia, cutaneous papules, and blue nevi. Endoscopic evaluations identified multiple bleeding lesions through the GI tract.

pmc-13062421.title: Beyond The Sprain, Unmasking a Rare Anterolateral Ankle Pathology in a Young Athlete
pmc-13062421.creator: Girish Motwani, Shubham Kalnawat, Khanjan Ahir, Kanishk Bhandari
pmc-13062421.description: Introduction:Chronic anterolateral ankle pain in young athletes is commonly attributed to ligament sprains, stress injuries, or tendinopathies. However, uncommon underlying pathologies may occasionally be responsible for persistent symptoms. Calcaneonavicular coalition is a congenital condition that can lead to chronic ankle pain and restricted hindfoot motion. The coexistence of calcaneonavicular coalition with a superficial ankle lipoma is extremely rare.

pmc-13224869.title: KLF18 is a necessary component of the DUX4-initiated transcriptional network and a candidate locus for phenotypic diversity
pmc-13224869.creator: Danielle C Hamm, Aidan B O'Donnell, Sean R Bennett, Richard JLF Lemmers, Patrick J van der Vliet, Silvère M van der Maarel, Stephen J Tapscott
pmc-13224869.description: In this study, Hamm et al. show that Krüppel-like factor 18 (KLF18) cooperates with transcription factor DUX4 to regulate totipotency-related gene expression during zygotic genome activation. KLF18 is polymorphic with a variable number of tandem repeats, and the resulting structural variation could account for the variability observed in disease severity in facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy.

pmc-13433575.title: Distinct enteric nervous system pattern in obstructed defecation syndrome and slow-transit constipation: a controlled digital pathology study
pmc-13433575.creator: Tillmann Bedau, Aryan Mirzaie-Kuzehgarani, Joshy Madukkakzhy, Luisa Halbe, Alexander Quaas, Claudia Rudroff
pmc-13433575.description: PurposeChronic constipation comprises heterogeneous clinical entities, including slow-transit constipation (STC) and functional defecation disorders such as obstructed defecation syndrome (ODS). Although neuroenteric mechanisms are implicated, reproducible histomorphological correlates remain incompletely defined, partly due to methodological heterogeneity and lack of standardized quantification.

pmc-13606209.description: Peach palm (Bactris gasipaes) heart is a sustainable, fiber- and polysaccharide-rich ingredient with potential for plant-based food structuring. This study investigated peach palm heart powder (PPHP) as a functional co-ingredient in soy protein isolate (SPI)-based inks for extrusion-based 3D food printing, focusing on rheology, printability, microstructure, molecular interactions, texture, and in vitro digestibility.
